b6_reason: Zero activation energy is possible (A true) and the definition of activation energy in R is correct (R true), but R only defines the term and does not explain why Ea can be zero.
b6_note: Options 1 and 2 are both defensible: R's definition (extra energy needed to reach threshold) can be read as explaining a zero value when reactants already possess threshold energy. Picked 2 as the usual intent; flagging as ambiguous.
